hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: Turning on the feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` exposed a divide-by-zero defect in the account-page spend calculation. The flag began evaluating `on` for part of traffic at 15:09 (154 off / 46 on) and 100% `on` from 15:10, exactly when errors jumped from ~1% baseline to ~32-38%, and every new error is `ZeroDivisionError: division by zero` - an error type that never appears while the flag is off. The remediation failed because the flag was not actually left off: the change log shows Argus's last action at 2026-09-12T15:21:49Z switched the flag ON again, and logs after 15:15:41 still read `monthly-spend-feature=on`.

supporting_evidence.claim: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (kind: flag-toggle, actor: admin)
ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
error_rate 0.005 at 15:08, 0.07 at 15:09, 0.325 at 15:10 with request_volume unchanged at 1200
All log lines before 15:09 read `monthly-spend-feature=off` and the only errors are `UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out` at 0-3% - no ZeroDivisionError while off
feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (actor: Argus) - the supposed 'set off' remediation left the flag on
INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations (still on after Argus's 15:15:41 off-toggle, errors continuing at 32-38%)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: the latent divide-by-zero bug in the account-page spend code was shipped by a code change and only became reachable when the flag was enabled. No deployment appears in the change record for io-shop over the six weeks read (2026-08-01 to 2026-09-12), so this is unsupported by the evidence in view; the flag toggle remains the only recorded change.

supporting_evidence.claim: Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-12T15:30:00Z contains only three flag-toggle entries for monthly-spend-feature and no deployments
